_comment: Lessons name voice SLOTS (male_1, male_2, female_1, female_2). A profile maps slots to real voices. Switch TTS provider by building with another profile; cache keys change only for lines whose voice changed. Voice names checked on official docs 3 Nov 2026 (Azure hi-IN list; Indic Parler-TTS card).

female_2.label: Priyamvada (higher)
female_2.note: Demo only: the one Piper Hindi female voice, pitch-shifted so two women in a scene sound different.

male_1.speaker: Aman
male_1.label: Aman
male_1.description: Aman delivers a slightly expressive and animated speech at a moderate speed with slightly low pitch. Very clear audio, close up, with no background noise.
male_1.verify: Chosen by ear on 2026-11-27 (style b); male confirmed.

male_2.speaker: Rohit
male_2.label: Rohit
male_2.description: Rohit speaks in an expressive, animated and friendly way, with lively rises and falls in pitch, at a moderate speed with moderate pitch. Very clear audio, close up, with no background noise.
male_2.verify: Second male voice (485 lines). Default style rated flat; style c is an untested guess, confirm by ear.

female_1.speaker: Rani
female_1.label: Rani
female_1.description: Rani speaks in a lively, expressive conversational style, like chatting warmly with a friend, smiling, with varied intonation, at a slightly fast pace with slightly high pitch. Very clear audio, close up, with no background noise.
female_1.verify: Chosen by ear on 2026-11-27 (style d); female confirmed.
